arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: The government claims the fraud scheme creates collateral U.S. criminal conduct.
the sides that brought the case claim the revenue rule prohibits this specific prosecution.
Justice Scalia questioned the applicability of reciprocity statutes to this case.
Justice Ginsburg noted that no U.S. law is violated by foreign tax enforcement.
